## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and behavior after this change.

## Change

Explain the implementation or documentation change and any parameter, protocol, dependency or upstream-version changes.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. State any GUI, full-firmware or hardware checks not performed. Attach only minimal synthetic or appropriately sanitized evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the documented scope, or explicitly proposes a scope change.
- [ ] A result-changing modification identifies its baseline and same-input comparison.
- [ ] Source timestamps, invalid states and telemetry fields remain documented where affected.
- [ ] No private logs, real location samples, credentials, downloaded dependencies or build caches are included.
- [ ] Licensing and source attribution are preserved.
